text: God’s foundation is set on the holy mountains.
The LORD loves Zion’s gates more than all of Jacob’s houses combined.
Glorious things are said about you, the city of God! Selah
I count Rahab and Babel among those who know me; also Philistia and Tyre, along with Cush — each of these was born there.
And of Zion it is said: “Each person was born in it, but the one who will establish it is the Most High.”
The LORD makes a record as he registers the peoples: “Each one was born there.” Selah
And while they dance, people sing: “The source of my life comes from you.”
